title: KServe V2 churn inference request
description: Request schema for the supplied native LightGBM artifact served by MLServer v4 under KServe V2.

FeatureRow.description: One ordered row of model features; width and semantic order are taken from the validated artifact feature manifest.

name.description: KServe tensor name read from the deployed model metadata/feature manifest; not guessed by the caller.

prefixItems.description: Feature count declared by the deployed ordered feature manifest.

datatype.description: KServe V2 FP32 input tensor type.

data.description: Rows align with shape[0]; every row width equals shape[1] and follows the exact artifact feature manifest order.

InputTensor.description: Single tabular feature matrix for native LightGBM serving.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

name.description: KServe output tensor name reported by the model metadata.

prefixItems.description: Number of predictions; equals input batch size.

shape.description: One result per row: [batch], or the MLServer NumPy codec shape [batch, 1].

datatype.description: Native LightGBM returns FP64 positive-class probabilities; legacy INT64 class outputs are also accepted.

data.description: One class ID or positive-class probability per input row, preserving input order.

parameters.description: Optional KServe V2 runtime metadata; tensor validation remains unchanged.

id.description: Request ID echoed by the inference server.

model_version.description: Served artifact version, which prediction-tools records with the result.

x-contract-guarantees.side_effects: Stateless inference; the model service does not mutate application database rows.
x-contract-guarantees.errors: Invalid tensor, model not ready, invalid model name, and artifact storage failures use KServe V2 error responses and map to INVALID_TENSOR, MODEL_NOT_READY, INVALID_MODEL_NAME, or STORAGE_ERROR.
x-contract-guarantees.timeouts_retries: Prediction-tools sets a 30 second per-batch deadline and retries one transient readiness/5xx failure after 500 milliseconds; invalid tensors and artifact mismatches are not retried.
x-contract-guarantees.ordering: Exactly one probability or legacy class output is returned per input row and row order is preserved. FP32/FP64 probabilities become class 1 only when greater than 0.5; ties map to class 0, matching the trained binary classifier.
x-contract-guarantees.versioning: KServe V2 is the wire protocol. The ordered semantic feature manifest and class metadata are versioned with the artifact and validated before inference.

x-preprocessing.source: Supplied churn training/serving pipeline at commit 3037c340c5a4a27ae53f95b9146562c12c985c79.
x-preprocessing.unresolved_artifact_metadata: The exact ordered feature names, width, input/output tensor names, and class-to-semantic-label mapping must come from the deployed artifact manifest; they are not specified in the architecture handoff.
